caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional statue of a standing man dressed in Native American attire, placed on a rectangular green base. The man has long, black hair and is wearing a large feathered headdress with feathers colored red, yellow, blue, green, and brown. He wears a tan or light brown tunic and trousers, adorned with decorative elements such as a circular medallion with a red and white design on his chest and white circular accents along the hem of his clothing. Over his shoulders, there is a light brown cape with a darker, fur-textured interior. On his right arm, there is a circular patch with a red design. He has a large white earring in his visible ear and holds a long white cylindrical object, possibly a pipe, in his right hand, while his left hand rests at his side. The shoes are tan and slightly pointed. The figure stands against a plain, off-white background.
title: Cigar Store Indian
